title: Democrats win Congress and Bitcoin rips back above $80K as $951M gets liquidated
caption:
democrats won both the house and senate and btc ripped back above $80k 🗳️ btc +4% near $80.4k, eth +6.3%, sol +3.8%. $951m liquidated in 24h, mostly shorts. trump token -17%. btc etfs -$116m tue, 3rd straight outflow day. boe today, us jobs report fri. not financial advice.
